nuggets.text: The Horned Frogs opened 2026 in Dublin, Ireland, facing Bill Belichick's North Carolina at Aviva Stadium.
Quarterback Jaden Craig came to TCU from Harvard, where he set the school record for career touchdown passes.
A horned frog is not a frog at all: TCU's mascot is the Texas horned lizard.
The Horned Frogs sometimes wear red as a nod to horned lizards shooting blood from their eyes as a defense.
TCU's mascot was called Addy the All-American Frog until 1979, when the name changed to SuperFrog.
The Horned Frog first appeared in 1897, on the cover of the very first AddRan yearbook.
Sonny Dykes arrived for his TCU introduction by helicopter, landing on the field at Amon G. Carter Stadium.
Sonny Dykes began his coaching career in 1994 as an assistant baseball coach.
Sonny Dykes is the son of Spike Dykes, Texas Tech's head coach from 1986 to 1999.
In Sonny Dykes' first season, 2022, the Horned Frogs went 12-1 and made their first College Football Playoff.
